verdict.rationale: Docs describe automatic schema handling, type mapping, capture-deletes, and multiple sync modes (soft-delete/live/history) that dedupe and normalize destination tables into typed, analytics-ready schemas rather than raw JSON, plus pre-built data models for analytics-ready tables (fivetran-docs-18, -33, -35, -13, -25, -57, -51, -66). Community praise for reliability corroborates the ELT value prop (fivetran-comm-1, -2, -14), though some report periodic out-of-sync incidents requiring re-syncs (fivetran-comm-13), a minor caveat rather than a concrete contradiction of typed/deduped output. missing for 10: independent technical audit or benchmark specifically verifying dedup correctness and type-mapping accuracy across connectors.
